title: AWEN photonic noise contract v1
description: Physical-unit analog error sources of a photonic matrix core. Fidelity: compact model. Null disables an optional term. See AEP-0022.

photons_per_mac.description: Mean photons contributed by one multiply-accumulate at full scale (unit: photons). Null disables shot and thermal noise.

phase_sigma_rad.description: Static phase-programming error standard deviation (unit: rad).

rin_db_per_hz.description: Laser relative intensity noise (unit: dB/Hz). Null disables RIN.

detection_bandwidth_hz.description: Detection bandwidth for RIN integration (unit: Hz).

thermal_noise_electrons.description: Input-referred detector thermal noise (unit: electrons rms per sample).

crosstalk_db.description: Adjacent-channel power crosstalk (unit: dB). Null disables crosstalk.

dac_bits.description: Signed DAC resolution (unit: bits). Null means ideal conversion.

adc_bits.description: Signed ADC resolution (unit: bits). Null means ideal conversion.
